meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告投放与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌广告账户的日常管理与效果提升。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and want to improve performance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能操作并优化 Google Ads 账户：查数据、出摘要，能暂停广告、调出价、增删否定词，变更会记录并在 7 天内可撤销，还会维护表现基线做异常检测。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Google Ads、广告系列等广告话题，或要求查看 CPA/ROAS 等指标时触发。

say.text: 查一下最近 7 天各广告系列的 CPA 和花费。
say.note: Claude 会拉取数据并汇总。

say.text: 把“运动鞋”关键词的出价从 1.5 改为 2 元。
say.note: 会先确认再执行，并返回变更 ID。

say.text: 给广告系列 A 添加否定关键词“免费”。
say.note: 会更新否定列表并关联到该广告系列。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude manages Google Ads: pulls performance data, summarizes it, executes changes (pauses, bids, negatives), records each write for 7-day undo, and keeps a performance baseline for anomaly detection.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Google Ads, campaigns, or asks to see metrics like CPA/ROAS.

say_en.text: Show CPA and spend per campaign for the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude pulls and summarizes the data.

say_en.text: Change the bid for 'sneakers' from 1.5 to 2.
say_en.note: It confirms, then executes and returns a change ID.

say_en.text: Add 'free' as a negative keyword to campaign A.
say_en.note: It updates the negative list and links it to the campaign.
